source.description.zh-Hans: rumanhua.org 的同名书站。它的榜单既有《神印王座》《绍宋》等国漫，也能找到《海贼王》和《神之塔》。
source.description.zh-Hant: rumanhua.org 的同名漫畫站。榜單既有《神印王座》《紹宋》等中國漫畫，也能找到《航海王》和《神之塔》。
source.description.en: The catalogue at rumanhua.org ranges from Chinese series such as Throne of Seal and Shao Song to One Piece and Tower of God.
